objects.name: Analytic 2280
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Windows serial port configuration changes on Industrial Control System (ICS) gateway hosts that would disrupt communication with serial field devices. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=13 to Communication (COM) port configuration key by process not in authorized serial port management tools

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window within which a serial gateway configuration change and subsequent device communication loss are considered causally connected.
